title: 第171章 真正的团队第170章 极致碾压
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
今日在索托大斗魂场，直面七连胜、开启狂热狂暴状态的巅峰狂战队，是他们第一次在真正的高压实战中，淋漓尽致地体会到团队配合这四个字真正的重量。
所有人心中都感触颇深，尤以戴沐白、小舞、朱竹清三人最为深刻。
回想战局最凶险的时刻，狂战队全员开启狂热增幅，力量、速度暴涨五成，彻底失去痛觉，攻势凶悍癫狂。
戴沐白独抗双犀牛强攻，被狂暴力量步步压制，身形岌岌可危；小舞贴身缠斗狂暴猴魂师，瞬间被对方暴涨的速度挣脱牵制，身陷险境；朱竹清游走袭扰，也被提速的敏攻魂师死死纠缠，难以脱身。
就在三人即将被狂暴攻势击中、难免受伤的刹那，是唐三凭借极致的战场预判，瞬间催动蓝银草，精准无误缠上三人腰身，迅猛而轻柔的力道一瞬拉扯，快、准、稳，瞬息间将他们全数扯回安全阵型之内。
就是这短短一秒的团队联动，硬生生帮三人避开了致命重创，稳住了濒临崩塌的阵型。
此刻回想起来，三人依旧心有余悸，也彻底读懂了大师日复一日强调配合、磨合阵型的深意。
单打独斗，逞的是个人勇武；可团战厮杀，一人强不算强，全员无漏、彼此托底、生死相依，才是真正的不败之道。
戴沐白长长吐出一口浊气，眼底满是感慨：“以前总觉得自己强攻战力足够，单打从不吃亏，今日才算真正明白，大师说的配合，从来不是多余的规矩，是能护住所有人性命的底气。”
小舞连连点头，眉眼柔和：“刚才太险了，对方狂暴之后完全不要命，若不是小三反应够快，我们肯定要受伤。团队作战，真的没人可以独自逞强。”
朱竹清微微颔首，清冷的眼眸里多了几分通透：“预判、补位、救援、牵制，每一步的默契，都是训练场无数次磨合换来的。”
众人纷纷附和，心中对团战配合、团队羁绊的理解，在这场实打实的硬仗之后，彻底刻入心底，远比千次训练、百次说教更加深刻。
人群之中，宁苒苒静静站在唐三身侧，晚风拂动她的发丝，眉眼清浅淡然。
整场战局，宁苒苒居中控场，看着唐三从开局锁控敌方双核、中途预判避险、绝境拉扯队友、最后精准大范围终结，每一步战术都稳到极致。
她一路配合他控场压制、领域削弱敌方狂暴战力，全程无需言语，两人心意相通、节奏同频。
此刻她侧过头，看向身侧少年，轻声开口，嗓音清软带着真切的赞许：“三哥刚刚的预判很稳。尤其是拉扯队友、找准窗口期升空避敌、熬掉对方狂热时效的战术，滴水不漏。”
唐三闻言，转头看向身旁的少女，眼底漾开温和的笑意，语气坦然真诚：“不是我一人的功劳。若不是苒苒你在关键时刻展露威压、震慑对手，又用冰火领域压制住他们的狂暴魂力，削弱对方的增幅战力，我们根本撑不到三分钟时效结束，也不会有这么轻松的收尾。”
他看得无比清楚。
狂战队开启狂热的瞬间，全员战力暴走，阵型濒临崩盘，是宁苒苒的三黑万年魂环带来的绝对威慑，打乱了敌方狂暴进攻的节奏。
也是她的冰火双重天领域，精准克制对方燥热暴戾的狂暴魂力，硬生生压垮了对方的战力峰值，为自己升空布局、全员休整争取了最关键的窗口期。

一人主控运筹，一人压场破局，无需提前商议，无需言语沟通，全程完美联动，这才是整场战局制胜的核心。
宁苒苒唇角微扬，眼底掠过一抹浅浅笑意：“我们本就是队友。你掌全局控制，我做后场压场，各司其职，便是最好的配合。”
简单两句对话，没有刻意的吹捧，只有彼此心知肚明的默契与认可。
一旁的马红俊挠了挠头，笑着打趣：“说实话，今天是真开眼了！小三控场无解，苒苒你的领域压制也太克制狂战队了，你俩联手，直接把对面的狂暴战力拿捏得死死的！”
奥斯卡晃了晃手中的香肠，笑意满满：“这就是顶级双核的默契吧！一个锁得住人，一个压得住场，我们跟着打配合太稳了。”
宁荣荣轻轻点头，琉璃眼眸清亮：“老师一直说团战讲究互补，今天我才算真正看懂，你们两人的配合，就是最完美的攻防互补。”
听着众人的感慨，前方的大师缓缓回头，清冷的眼眸扫过八名少年少女，脸上难得露出一丝浅淡的赞许。
“你们今日的感悟，胜过百次训练。”
“个人魂力、魂技固然重要，但真正的团战，拼的永远是默契、判断与取舍。你们今日不仅赢了比赛，更赢了心境，读懂了团队二字，这场胜利，远比积分更加珍贵。”
晚风徐徐，拂过八个并肩而立的少年少女。
经历过这场惊心动魄的硬仗，史莱克八怪的羁绊愈发深厚。每个人都彻底褪去了几分青涩，多了几分实战沉淀的沉稳。
而唐三与宁苒苒一控一压、相辅相成的顶级默契，也深深烙印在所有人心中，成为史莱克八怪最稳固、最无可替代的团战核心。
夜色渐深，索托城的街面灯火零星，晚风裹着几分凉意拂过巷口。
史莱克一行人脚步轻快地回到落脚的旅馆，廊下的灯笼晕开暖黄的光，映着八张尚且带着薄汗、眼底发亮的脸庞。
刚放下东西，大师的随从便来传话，请所有人到他的房间一叙，弗兰德与赵无极也已在那里等候。
八人相视一眼，整了整衣衫，陆续走了过去。
推开房门，暖黄的油灯光线铺满整间屋子。大师背着手站在窗前，身形依旧挺拔瘦削；弗兰德斜倚在桌边，指尖转着一枚金币，嘴角噙着惯有的笑意；赵无极抱臂站在墙角，虎目里满是藏不住的欣慰。
屋子里摆着几张木椅和一条长凳，并不算宽敞，八人鱼贯而入后，反倒添了几分热闹的人气。
content_en:
Today at the Soto Spirit Arena, facing the Peak Madness Team, which has won seven consecutive games and started a frenzied and violent state, it is the first time that they have vividly realized the true weight of the four words of teamwork in a real high-pressure actual battle.
Everyone was deeply touched, especially Dai Mubai, Xiao Wu, and Zhu Zhuqing.
Recalling the most dangerous moment of the battle, all members of the Mad Battle Team started to increase their fanaticism, their strength and speed increased by 50%, they completely lost their sense of pain, and their attacks were fierce and crazy.
Dai Mubai resisted the strong attack of the two rhinos, but was suppressed step by step by the violent force, and his body was in danger; Xiao Wu fought closely with the violent monkey spirit master, but was instantly broken away by the opponent's sudden increase in speed, and was in danger; Zhu Zhuqing wandered around to harass, but was also entangled by the agility spirit master who accelerated his speed, making it difficult to escape.
Just when the three of them were about to be hit by the violent attack and inevitably injured, it was Tang San who relied on his ultimate battlefield prediction to instantly activate the Bluesilver Grass, wrap it around the waist of the three of them with precision, and pull them with swift yet gentle force, quickly, accurately, and steadily, pulling them all back into a safe formation in an instant.
It was this brief second of teamwork that helped the three of them avoid fatal damage and stabilize the formation that was on the verge of collapse.
Looking back at this moment, the three of them still have lingering fears, and they have fully understood the master's emphasis on cooperation and harmonizing the formation day after day.
When fighting alone, one is showing off one's own bravery; but when fighting in a team, one person is not strong enough. The only way to be truly invincible is to have all the members involved, support each other, and depend on each other for life and death.
Dai Mubai exhaled a long breath, his eyes full of emotion: "I used to feel that I had enough offensive power and never suffered a loss in single combat. Today I truly understand that the cooperation mentioned by the master is never a superfluous rule, but the confidence that can protect everyone's lives."
Xiao Wu nodded repeatedly, with soft eyebrows: "It was too dangerous just now. The opponent was completely desperate after going berserk. If Xiao San hadn't reacted quickly enough, we would have been injured. In a team fight, no one can really be strong alone."
Zhu Zhuqing nodded slightly, and his cold eyes were a little more transparent: "Prejudgment, replacement, rescue, containment, the tacit understanding of every step is the result of countless runs in the training ground."
Everyone agreed, and their understanding of teamfight cooperation and team bonding was completely engraved in their hearts after this real tough battle, which was far more profound than a thousand trainings and a hundred lectures.
Among the crowd, Ning Ranran stood quietly beside Tang San, her hair was ruffled by the evening breeze, her eyebrows were light and indifferent.
Throughout the battle, Ning Ranran was in the middle and controlled the field, watching Tang San lock the enemy's dual cores from the beginning, predicting and avoiding danger in the middle, pulling his teammates in desperate situations, and finally finishing in a large area with precision. Every step of his tactics was extremely stable.
She cooperated with him all the way to control the field and suppress it, weakening the enemy's violent combat power. No words were needed during the whole process. The two of them were connected and in the same rhythm.
At this moment, she turned her head, looked at the boy beside her, and spoke softly, her voice soft and full of genuine approval: "The third brother's prediction just now was very solid. Especially the tactics of pulling teammates, finding the right window period to launch into the air to avoid the enemy, and overcoming the opponent's frenzy and time limit, they are all watertight."
Hearing this, Tang San turned to look at the girl next to him, with a gentle smile in his eyes, and said calmly and sincerely: "It's not my fault alone. If it weren't for Ranran who showed your coercion at the critical moment, intimidating the opponent, and also used the ice and fire domain to suppress their violent soul power and weaken the opponent's increased combat power, we would never have been able to survive the three-minute time limit, and we wouldn't have had such an easy ending."
He could see it very clearly.
The moment when the mad battle team started to become frenzied, all members went berserk and the formation was on the verge of collapse. It was the absolute deterrence brought by Ning Ranran's three-black ten thousand-year soul ring that disrupted the enemy's violent attack.
It is also her dual realm of ice and fire that can accurately restrain the opponent's hot and violent violent soul power, crushing the opponent's peak combat power, and gaining the most critical window period for her to take off and prepare for everyone to rest.
One person controlsPlanning, one person to win the game, no need to discuss in advance, no need to communicate verbally, perfect coordination throughout the whole process, this is the core of winning the entire battle.
The corners of Ning Ranran's lips raised slightly, and a faint smile flashed across her eyes: "We are teammates. You control the situation, and I hold the backcourt. Each performs his or her own duties. This is the best cooperation."
A simple two-sentence conversation, no deliberate flattery, only mutual understanding and recognition.
Ma Hongjun on the side scratched his head and joked with a smile: "To be honest, today is really an eye-opener! Xiaosan has no solution for controlling the field, and Ranran, your field suppression is too restrained for the Berserker team. The two of you joined forces and directly controlled the opponent's violent combat power!"
Oscar shook the sausage in his hand and said with a smile: "This is the tacit understanding of the top two cores! One can lock people in, and the other can suppress the field. Our cooperation is too stable."
Ning Rongrong nodded lightly, Liuli's eyes were clear: "Teacher has always said that team battles are about complementarity. Today I really understand. The cooperation between the two of you is the most perfect complementation of offense and defense."
Listening to everyone's emotions, the master in front slowly turned his head, his cold eyes swept across the eight boys and girls, and there was a rare hint of faint approval on his face.
"What you learned today is better than a hundred training sessions."
"Individual soul power and soul skills are important, but a real team battle always involves tacit understanding, judgment and choice. You not only won the game today, but also won the state of mind and understood the word team. This victory is far more precious than points."
The evening breeze blew slowly past eight young girls standing side by side.
After experiencing this thrilling and tough battle, the bond between the Shrek Eight Monsters has become deeper and deeper. Everyone has completely lost some of their youthfulness, and gained a little more calmness accumulated in actual combat.
And Tang San and Ning Ranran's top-notch tacit understanding of controlling and pressing, complementing each other, has also been deeply imprinted in everyone's hearts, becoming the most stable and irreplaceable core of the Shrek Eight Monsters in team battles.
The night is getting darker, the streets of Soto City are dimly lit, and the evening breeze is blowing through the alleys with a bit of coolness.
Shrek and his party walked briskly back to the hotel where they stayed. The lanterns in the corridor dimmed the warm yellow light, reflecting eight faces with a thin layer of sweat and bright eyes.
As soon as he put down his things, the master's entourage came to send a message, asking everyone to come to his room to talk, where Flanders and Zao Wou-Ki were already waiting.
The eight people looked at each other, straightened their clothes, and walked over one after another.
Pushing open the door, the warm yellow oil lamp light filled the entire room. The master stood in front of the window with his hands behind his back, his figure still tall and thin; Flanders was leaning on the table, spinning a gold coin on his fingertips, with his usual smile on his lips; Zao Wuji stood in the corner with his arms folded, his eyes filled with uncontrollable relief.
There were several wooden chairs and a bench in the room, which was not very spacious. After eight people filed in, it actually became more lively.
